name: Solid Voxelization based on Quadtree
definition: A voxelization method using quad trees for spatial acceleration and storing intersection distances in 2D planes to determine voxel type (shell, interior, background) without a full 3D buffer during computation.
summary: Solid Voxelization based on Quadtree is a memory-efficient technique that uses 2D quadtree structures to store plane-wise intersections, enabling high-resolution voxelization where other methods fail due to memory constraints.
